nodes.name: buffs.ts
nodes.summary: Pure constants module defining buff/debuff potency and duration values for the Voxel Blade damage engine. Exports 132 named numeric constants covering potion effects, rune-granted buffs, weapon-art buffs, True Balance conversions, perk buff factory values, buff potency modifiers, and generic debuff modifiers. No functions or classes — serves as a centralized data registry consumed by the buff calculation engine.

edges.detail: BuffData.ts consumes buff constants for BUFF_DEFS, BASIC_DEBUFF_POOL, getWeaponArtBuffs, getTrueBalanceBuffs, applyBuffPerkModifiers, and other buff calculation functions
build.ts uses buff constants indirectly through the buff calculation pipeline in calcBuild
